_why: THE WIRE CONTRACT of /lb/stream's `patch` events (vllm_lb/status_delta.py writes them, vllm_lb/static/status_delta.js applies them). Each case: `a` the status the page holds, `b` the next one, `patch` what diff(a, b) must write. tests/test_status_delta.py checks diff and apply in Python; tests/status_delta.node.js checks the page's apply against the same patches.

cases.name: an unchanged document is no patch
a key that appears is set, one that goes is removed
a full ring that took one sample shifts by one and pushes it
a ring that is still filling only pushes
a ring that took two samples while full shifts by two
a newest-first list that took one row drops its oldest and puts the row in front
a newest-first list still filling only puts rows in front
a list of objects of the same length is edited item by item
a list that changed in any other way is replaced whole
a value that changes type is replaced
null in place of a value is a value, not a removal
a number that is the same value is unchanged whether int or float
true is not 1: a bool that becomes a number is set
nested: a ring inside a backend inside a list
the whole document replaced when it is not an object
